title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: A monster hunter searches a war-torn continent for his adopted daughter in a sprawling open-world RPG full of morally grey choices.

title: Hades
description: Fight your way out of the Underworld again and again in a fast roguelike where every failed escape moves the story forward.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit a run-down farm, grow crops, befriend the townsfolk and explore the mines at your own relaxed pace.

title: Elden Ring
description: Explore the Lands Between, a vast and dangerous open world, and take on demanding bosses to claim the Elden Ring.

title: Celeste
description: Guide Madeline up a treacherous mountain in a precise platformer about anxiety, perseverance and a lot of retries.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: Race hundreds of cars across a festival-filled open world set in the varied landscapes of Mexico.

title: Portal 2
description: Solve physics puzzles with a portal gun inside an abandoned research facility, solo or in co-op with a friend.

title: Resident Evil 4
description: A rebuilt survival-horror classic: rescue the president's daughter from a sinister cult in rural Europe.

title: Civilization VI
description: Lead a civilisation from the stone age to the space age through diplomacy, science, culture and conquest.

title: Street Fighter 6
description: A modern entry in the long-running fighting series with a new control scheme for newcomers and deep systems for veterans.

title: Doom Eternal
description: Tear through demonic hordes in a relentless, high-speed first-person shooter built around aggressive movement.

title: It Takes Two
description: A co-op-only adventure where a couple on the verge of divorce must work together through ever-changing gameplay.
